title: The radioactive 103Pd and 109Pd palladium bipyridyl–bisphosphonate complexes for radionuclide therapy of bone metastatic tumor cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18501-18511
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02172C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Geeva Prasanth Annamalaisamy, Monika Lyczko, Aleksander Bilewicz
The radioactive 103Pd and 109Pd palladium bipyridyl–bisphosphonate complexes for radionuclide therapy of bone metastatic tumor cells were studied. The complexes demonstrated stability and a strong affinity for the main mineral component of bones.
